snippet.title: UNGALAND! Game Preview! Get Ready for the Adventure!
snippet.description:
"Get a first glimpse of UngaLand!, an exciting prehistoric adventure where you explore a vibrant world, unlock powerful abilities, and face awesome challenges. Watch this gameplay preview to discover world and story behind our upcoming single-player game.
Support us on 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ungaland/ungaland
Join the adventure and stay updated by following us:
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/unga.land/?hl=en
🐥X: https://x.com/Ungaland_game
📧 Contact: ungaland@mevstudio.net

Sign up for the playtest and become part of the journey!"
at : www.mevstudio.net/ungaland
